data.name: Intro
data.value: Use AheadSubs from local agents and scripts to translate text, generate SRT files, or control subtitle look-ahead. Start the subtitle service on the Translation page first.

data.name: McpHint
data.value: Add the configuration to a local stdio client. The client starts MCP when it connects. If you use a cloud model, requests go to your configured provider.

data.name: CliHint
data.value: After installation, reopen your terminal and run aheadsubs status. Run aheadsubs --help to see the available commands.

data.name: SourceHint
data.value: From a source checkout, run python -m pip install . in the project directory to install the CLI.

data.name: EnabledNotice
data.value: MCP access is enabled. Copy the configuration, then reconnect your client.

data.name: InstalledNotice
data.value: Added to your user PATH. Reopen your terminal.

data.name: ClipboardUnavailable
data.value: The clipboard is unavailable. Select the configuration text to copy it manually.

data.name: Failed
data.value: Could not update integrations. Check the application and try again.
